The '''2020–21 National First Division''' (called the GladAfrica Championship for sponsorship reasons) was the season from November 2020 to May 2021 of South Africa's second tier of professional [[association football|soccer]], the [[National First Division]].

==Teams==

16 teams competed in the season.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Summary - 1st Division - South Africa - Results, fixtures, tables and news - Soccerway |url=https://us.soccerway.com/national/south-africa/1st-division/20202021/regular-season/r59955/ |access-date=2020-11-28 |website=us.soccerway.com}}</ref>

==Play-offs==

The playoffs were won by [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]], who retained their place in the [[2021-22 South African Premier Division]].  [[Royal AM F.C.|Royal AM]] refused to participate, instead buying their way into the top tier by purchasing the franchise of [[Bloemfontein Celtic F.C.|Bloemfontein Celtic]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-08-17 |title=Bloemfontein Celtic sold: Renamed Royal AM |url=https://en.africatopsports.com/2021/08/17/dstv-premiership-bloemfontein-celtic-sold-renamed-royal-am/ |access-date=2022-08-20 |website=Africa Top Sports |language=en-US |archive-date=17 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250317203057/https://en.africatopsports.com/2021/08/17/dstv-premiership-bloemfontein-celtic-sold-renamed-royal-am/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
